patch_description: Replace the serial nearest-neighbor CZ line with two disjoint brickwork matchings and close the ring through qubits 7 and 0. The prior staggered layout achieved the same accuracy at substantially lower depth than the current serial ordering. Adding the missing wraparound edge removes boundary-qubit asymmetry and gives every qubit equal entangling degree without adding trainable parameters. This should preserve parameter efficiency, improve global feature mixing across re-upload blocks, and reduce circuit depth for faster optimization.
